modify the protected checkout or retained production artifacts

notes: Human approval is bounded to this project and controller v2.2. Candidate-controlled Python never runs directly on the host: the immutable reviewed Linux image is non-root, has NetworkMode=none, a read-only root, all capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges plus builtin seccomp, fixed resource limits, one read-only disposable workspace bind, and bounded /tmp and /output tmpfs mounts. Candidate training output crosses the boundary only as a bounded base64 bundle with per-file hashes and safe relative paths. The Python audit guard remains defense-in-depth for the historical Windows canary but is not a security boundary. The child-only ACL lease remains limited to the Windows patch/write plane and is exactly restored after container quiescence. Image builds are reviewed maintenance actions, and any image, Docker, policy, recipe, lock, attestation, or control-file drift invalidates this authorization. Ten cycles are attempts, not version-number increments or guaranteed improvements. A 100/100 result means every deterministic gate, seven final specialists, independent final QA, and paired hidden-fold evaluation passed; it still requires human review and grants no automatic promotion. The run, ACL-recovery, and container-recovery ledgers are same-machine tamper evidence, not external signatures.
